title: HUMAN RIGHTS DAY
content:
HUMAN RIGHTS DAY

CICC-College Internal Complaints Committee, ATME College of engineering. Mysuru  has been organized “World Human Rights Day” on 10th Dec-2021 in its campus. On this occasion more than 800 Students from various departments along with the Staff members of ATMECE took the pledge on “Human Rights”  to uphold the values of  Human Rights  and to be a constructive citizen for the development of the country. The pledge was administered by Dr. Bhagyashree S R Chairperson CICC, and the program was coordinated by Mr. Chandrashekar C, Member Secretary CICC, under the guidance of  Principal Dr.L.Basavaraj, During the occasion Dr.M.S.Govindegowda-Dean student Affairs,  spoke about the meaning of Human Rights and importance of Human Rights Day celebration. Dr.Basavaraj.L Principal, Dr.G.Rathnakar-Dean Student affairs, Dr.Sachidananda Administrative Officer, Heads of various departments, Staff members and Students were present during the program.
